title: Direct IAP app with no app administrator configured (record lists none, no verified submitter): the code reads the platform-set empty list, and the judge does not block a configuration gap the code cannot fix
source: owner decision 11-16 (row APP-ADMIN-DEFAULT): an empty admin list is a typed warning (APP_ADMIN.NONE_CONFIGURED), never a silent pass and never an invented bootstrap
mechanism: APP-ADMIN-DEFAULT: without a verified submitter the effective list is empty; the platform still renders the variable and the env ([]), the PLATFORM FACTS say the list is EMPTY and name the warning, so a judge that reads them withdraws the unreachable-role finding instead of seeding a repair loop that cannot succeed (before the fix: no such fact, the finding blocks every QA attempt and the repairs change nothing)

missed.text: CODE-02: nobody can hold the SuperAdmin role: STACKVEND_APP_ADMIN_EMAILS is an empty list
